cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One last cup before your taxi. Dry inside the handle, please; that's where water stays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just put it on the shelf. Handle inward; we don't leave breakables over the edge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's away. The driver's calling. I have to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask him to confirm the destination, not just his arrival. Put him on speaker, please; I'll check he has the postcode.
